meta.title: dsh-subagent-registry
meta.description: Registers ~/.dsh/agents/*.md as callable subagents (use_agent) with continuable background dispatch and ask_agent follow-ups.

subagents.commandDescription: Manage subagents: toggle roster agents on/off, install opt-in agents (ptc-subagent / minimal-subagent), flip the codemode (PTC) toolchain switch.
subagents.askUnavailable: No ask surface is available (the userQuestions service is not mounted). Edit the dsh-subagent-registry entry config manually (profile cordis.patch.yml or the settings page).
subagents.askFailed: The wizard could not complete ({error}). Configure manually, see below.
subagents.manualHint: Manual configuration: set disabledAgents (array of agent names hidden from the roster; agent files are never touched) and ptcEnabled (true/false — the codemode toolchain switch, applied on the next plugin mount) on the dsh-subagent-registry entry config (profile cordis.patch.yml or the settings page). Opt-in agents install by copying templates/opt-in-agents/<language>/<name>.md from the package into ~/.dsh/agents/ (existing files are never overwritten).
subagents.qDisableQuestion: Check the agents to disable (unchecked = enabled).
subagents.qDisableDetail: Disabling only hides an agent from the use_agent roster and refuses calls by name; the agent file is never modified. Currently disabled names must STAY checked to remain disabled.
subagents.markDisabled: currently disabled — keep checked to stay disabled, uncheck to re-enable
subagents.qOptInQuestion: Check the opt-in agents to install / keep enabled (both Experimental — disabled by default).
subagents.qOptInDetail: Experimental — disabled by default. Installing copies the template into the agents dir (an existing file is never overwritten; unchecking never deletes a copied file).
subagents.qAgyQuestion: Choose "Enable agy (Experimental)" or "Disable agy". Skip this question to leave the switch unchanged.
subagents.qAgyDetail: Current: {agyState} · {agyCommand}. Foreground one-shot only (no background/resume). Concurrency is capped by agyMaxConcurrent (default 1); an extra call fails fast with ACP_BUSY. Permission prompts are decided by the local agy's own settings — the registry does not answer for you.
subagents.qAgyEnableDesc: Billed to the Gemini plan · foreground only · concurrency capped by agyMaxConcurrent
subagents.qAgyDisableDesc: Removed from the use_agent roster; nothing is dispatched to agy
subagents.ptcBlurb: Experimental. Batch decision-work specialist; links ptcEnabled (the codemode toolchain).
subagents.minimalBlurb: Experimental. Minimal terminal-only executor (leaf); no config linkage.
subagents.ptcEnabledLine: ptcEnabled → true: the codemode tool registers on the next plugin mount (dsh restart).
subagents.ptcDisabledLine: ptcEnabled → false: the codemode tool will not register (applied on the next mount); an installed ptc-subagent.md is kept but excluded from the roster.
subagents.agyBlurb: Experimental. agy (Google Antigravity CLI) via ACP, billed to the Google AI plan; foreground one-shot only — dispatch one task at a time.
subagents.agyEnabledLine: agyEnabled → true: the registry-acp provider registers and "agy" joins the roster on the next plugin mount (dsh restart).
subagents.agyDisabledLine: agyEnabled → false: the registry-acp provider is removed and "agy" leaves the roster on the next plugin mount (dsh restart).
subagents.agyStatusLine: Experimental: agy dispatches through Google Antigravity CLI over ACP, billed to the Google AI plan (not the dsh model quota). It reads/writes files and runs commands in the current working directory, and the hooks in that directory WILL RUN; permission prompts are auto-answered per agyPermission (default reject). Foreground one-shot only; each call waits for agy to exit (task time plus up to ~9s teardown). With parent delivery, each call also posts one settlement notice (with the agy output) back into the parent session, so the main model may take one extra turn.
subagents.rosterRefreshFailed: Roster refresh failed: {error} — it applies when the management page is reopened or on the next dispatch.
subagents.settingsUnavailable: Settings service unavailable; no config was written.
